assumptions: Named question: can the captured convex first-order model give reaction enclosures across explicit stiffness intervals, permitting contact switches, without another force solve?

The published conjugate/weak-duality definitions support the derivation; this project derives its radial-clearance conjugate, coefficient perturbation bound and Cauchy reaction enclosures. It is not a published qualification of this frame.

The unchanged-law control and factors [0.5,2] and [0.1,10] are predeclared mathematical sensitivity families. They are not observed or published physical extrema. EC5 service slip and NDS gamma describe different quantities and do not justify those whole-model intervals.

The old elastic core is assumed positive semidefinite by its linear-elastic construction, and the trial core obeys alpha*K0 <= Knew <= beta*K0 in Loewner order with the same kernel. A nonnegative seed energy and symmetry check are not an independent PSD proof. No finite-body, effective-restraint or finished-stock property bound is inferred.

All positive common-shaft bearing, shaft-end capture, timber-face and flange-contact coefficients vary in the family interval. Their kinematic maps, normal cones and radial clearances are unchanged. Panel/screw/contact and floor normal/XY coefficients stay fixed; their energies remain in the proof and their physical behavior remains unqualified.

Replay recovers the measured residual g0 from each unchanged saved field. The dual-feasible load is exactly the floating-model f_hat=f+g0, not the original f. Record its hashes and both residual norms; do not discard g0 or claim a bound at f without a residual-to-response proof.

Let Q be the sum of old quadratic complementary energies, L=sum(clearance*norm(lateral_force)), and Qvar omit fixed spring kinds. Verify C0=Q+L=-Pi(q0)+q0.g0 and q0.f_hat=2Q+L. The seed is stationary under f_hat, assuming the stated convex core.

Fenchel gap is at most eta*Qvar with eta=max((alpha-1)^2/alpha,(beta-1)^2/beta). For every attained equilibrium in the trial family, sum(norm(delta_r_j)^2/(2*knew_j)) <= eta*Qvar. Each vector port uses its maximum positive axial/lateral coefficient for a valid norm enclosure; inactive normal/radial contacts can switch.

For an own two-Gauss wood interval, resultant change <= sqrt(2*gap*sum(beta*kl)), and couple change about its own midpoint <= sqrt(2*gap*sum(beta*kl*arm_squared)). Old signed source forces and their actual Gauss stations are retained. Free couples and other joint actions are not replaced by this bearing-only enclosure.

Add 0.001 Nmm to Qvar before gap evaluation as a declared numerical padding and check work identities within 1e-5 Nmm. This is a floating-point arithmetic evaluation of an exact mathematical inequality, not an interval-arithmetic rounding certificate.

Wood-land upper mean pressure is compared to the preserved 625-psi perpendicular compression reference on the least catalog-profile ring area. An upper index above one is a failure to certify that scalar reference across the family, not an actual force, an observed failure or complete joint strength. Local bearing/crushing, splitting, washer/heel interaction and finished-member capacities are not created.

The fixed rear-leg XY law defines an outer mathematical family; unbearing restrained-leg solutions would still be inadmissible in the selected no-slip support scenario. No new equilibrium, existence, displacement bound, floor bearing/friction credit, anchor or directional physical restraint proof is established.

Fixed first-order geometry, fixed applied captured body loads, unchanged contact maps and positive coefficient cones are essential. Geometric updates, changed fitting condensation loads, material yielding/fracture and post-failure redistribution lie outside this bound.

Retain 100 bolts, 66 Hillman axes, rejected-proposal history, panel/screw deferral and excluded actual fit. No native/frame/elastic solve, CAD rebuild, geometry change, archive, prune, staging or publication is performed by this consumer.
